title: umlx5h/LLPlayer
summary: LLPlayer is a language learning media player built with C#/WPF that provides dual subtitle support, AI-generated subtitles using Whisper for automatic speech recognition, real-time translation powered by Ollama LLMs, and video downloading via yt-dlp.
problem_solved: Enables language learners to watch videos with dual subtitles and get real-time AI translations directly in their media player.
why_valuable: It combines multiple AI capabilities (ASR, translation) into a seamless video player experience, making authentic language learning content more accessible without manual subtitle creation.
